active_request_manifest.note: The manifest's earlier not-uploaded and quote-pending state is preserved; this later plan binds the verified upload and live quote observations without changing it.

live_read_only_quote_observation.quote_caveat: These are point-in-time readbacks, not a reserved balance or spend receipt.

pre_submission_checks: Verify both immutable submission intents still bind these exact prompt, upload, and request-manifest hashes and all four media IDs in each request.
Read back current provider balance and exact 9-second and 7-second quote with the same parameters; do not rely on the point-in-time observation as a reservation.
Account for every already-consumed avatar call and quoted credit across Shorts 02 through 04 before each submission; hold if six calls or 1200 quoted credits would be exceeded.
Submit one candidate per shot, once. Preserve returned job IDs. A partial response, timeout, unknown result, or failed job is not retry permission.
post_generation: Inspect new footage and keep the continuous full-length Original C as final program voice. Owner listening and finished private phone review are deferred, not passed.
